exposure: distance of the placental cord insertion from the placental edge (PCI-D)
cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton gestations undergoing obstetric ultrasound examinations between 14 and 23 weeks' gestation with a cervical length of greater than 3.0 cm who delivered between 24 and 42 weeks
finding: The distance of the placental cord insertion from the placental edge (PCI-D) was associated with a low placental position in the second trimester.
mod_finding: The PCI-D was not associated with mode of delivery.
